note: Declarative label taxonomy for LLM-Mailroom-Services/Digital-Mailroom (HUB-014). Source of truth for scripts/github_labels.py sync/audit. Bridge between GitHub issues and the governance/TASKS.md lanes: stage/* mirrors the five board lanes, attention/* mirrors the needs_attention tags (needs:/review:/decision:), type/* and priority/* classify work, domain/* scopes it to the hub or a package, and kanban marks a synced board card (one card = one issue). Colors may repeat; names must not. Sync with: python scripts/github_labels.py sync

labels.name: stage/unassigned
labels.description: Board lane: unassigned - queued and unclaimed; free for the next agent or team to claim

labels.name: stage/assigned
labels.description: Board lane: assigned - claimed or queued with an owner, nothing underway (no draft, no diff)

labels.name: stage/in-progress
labels.description: Board lane: in_progress - work exists and one owner holds it; labeled before the code, never after

labels.name: stage/needs-attention
labels.description: Board lane: needs_attention - blocked, review, or decision pending (Evidence names which)

labels.name: stage/done
labels.description: Board lane: done - finished, verified, evidenced; issue closed with the archive commit

labels.name: attention/blocked
labels.description: Card carries a 'needs:' tag - blocked on something specific (what unblocks it is named in Evidence)

labels.name: attention/review
labels.description: Card carries a 'review:' tag - work exists, review evidence pending

labels.name: attention/decision
labels.description: Card carries a 'decision:' tag - awaiting a decision (the question is stated in Evidence)

labels.name: type/bug
labels.description: Something is broken: workspace wiring, sync driver, packaging, docs, or the board itself

labels.name: type/feature
labels.description: New capability or enhancement for the monorepo

labels.name: type/task
labels.description: TODO item / board-card work item (DMR-0NN) - the default work unit

labels.name: type/docs
labels.description: Documentation-only change (README/AGENTS/TASKS/package docs)

labels.name: type/governance
labels.description: Board laws, agent conventions, templates, or workflow discipline

labels.name: type/release
labels.description: Release-train work: pin bumps, upstream push, tagging (see HUB-005 scope)

labels.name: type/sync
labels.description: Sub-package sync: subtree pull/push, cursor moves, upstream drift reconciliation

labels.name: priority/critical
labels.description: Blocks other work; must land immediately

labels.name: priority/high
labels.description: High priority - lands before routine work

labels.name: priority/medium
labels.description: Normal priority

labels.name: priority/low
labels.description: Low priority - when capacity allows

labels.name: domain/hub
labels.description: Monorepo-level scope: workspace wiring, root docs, cross-package work

labels.name: domain/governance
labels.description: governance/ board, AGENTS.md, issue/PR templates, workflow discipline

labels.name: domain/tooling
labels.description: scripts/ tooling (sync_packages.py, board_state.py, github_labels.py) and CI workflows

labels.name: domain/enron-evaluation-environment
labels.description: packages/Enron-Evaluation-Environment - corpus feed (74-test suite)

labels.name: domain/the-mailroom
labels.description: packages/The-Mailroom - visualizer

labels.name: domain/agent-mailroom
labels.description: packages/agent-mailroom - walking-office-floor mailroom

labels.name: domain/claims-data-eda
labels.description: packages/claims-data-eda - corpus feed (30-test suite)

labels.description: packages/llm-dojo-scoring - shared scoring engine

labels.name: domain/llm-mailroom

labels.name: domain/llm-mailroom-graph
labels.description: packages/llm-mailroom-graph - derived graph site (virtual member)

labels.name: domain/local-mailroom-sandbox

labels.name: domain/mailroom-corpus-eda

labels.name: kanban
labels.description: Synced board card: mirrors a DMR-0NN card on governance/TASKS.md (board = source of truth)
